_description: P5 + HIGH severity + KEV. Inherits P5's layer routing; adds two new gate triggers. HIGH requires stronger independent evidence (EPSS > 0.5) than CRITICAL because severity labels disagree across scanners. KEV catalog membership blocks regardless of severity when a fix is available. Image lifecycle (EOL) is reported on every deny message but does not affect the gate decision: that policy belongs to the CI workflow, not Rego.
